notes.title: The demo has been launched, welcome to experience it!
notes.content:
Update:
1. Tutorial: The tutorial has been remade with clearer logic.
2. Archive format: To reduce the difficulty of opening, new archives come with free parts for easy construction.
3. Significantly reduce the difficulty of initial levels.

New:
1. Jackpot machine: The obtained parts can be extracted from the Jackpot machine, greatly reducing the difficulty of obtaining parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059993/3ec2f4373d488bfbe2fb84bfcacaf266d36d52a7.png
2. Test field: After the construction of the mecha is completed, direct testing is allowed in the test field.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059993/7ae478cf40150738af0733534fcea9e598a618bf.png
3. Ironman mode: Allow the Ironman mode to be turned off, significantly reducing difficulty and minimizing parts acquisition.
